llm.summary: The skill's behavior and requirements match its purpose (publishing files to here.now) and the included script implements the documented API flow, but the package origin has no homepage and the tool stores sensitive claim tokens/keys in local files which the user should handle carefully.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, SKILL.md, and scripts/publish.sh are consistent: the script builds a file manifest, calls here.now API endpoints, uploads files to presigned URLs, finalizes the publish, and saves state/credentials. Required binaries (curl, jq, file) are reasonable for this purpose. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions focus on publishing: running ./scripts/publish.sh, using the sign-up curl endpoint, and saving an API key to ~/.herenow/credentials. The script also reads/writes .herenow/state.json in the working directory to store claim tokens for anonymous publishes. This is functional but worth noting because the state file contains sensitive claim tokens and may be accidentally committed or exposed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or remote downloads; the skill is instruction-only with an included shell script. This minimizes install risk. The script requires standard CLI tools (curl, jq, file) which are expected for the task.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No unexpected environment variables are required. The script will read HERENOW_API_KEY and/or ~/.herenow/credentials which is proportional to the service. However, sensitive tokens (API key and anonymous claimToken) are stored in plain files: credentials file (user-guided to be chmod 600) and .herenow/state.json (no explicit perms set). Storing claim tokens in the working directory/state file can expose them (e.g., if the project is committed to a repo).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no global system changes. The script creates ~/.herenow/credentials and a .herenow/ state directory in the working directory; it does not modify other skills or system-wide agent settings. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default (platform behavior) but is not escalated here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says — publish static files to here.now — and the included script implements the API flows described. Before installing or running it: 1) Verify you trust the here.now service and the skill source (the package has no homepage and an unknown owner). 2) Never pass API keys on the command line; follow the guidance to save them to ~/.herenow/credentials and set file perms (chmod 600). 3) Be aware that anonymous claim tokens are saved to .herenow/state.json in the working directory; add that path to your .gitignore and avoid running the script in repos where secrets could be committed. 4) Inspect scripts/publish.sh yourself (or run in an isolated environment) before use. 5) Prefer to manually copy API keys from the dashboard rather than letting an agent fetch them. 6) Ensure curl, jq, and file are the versions you expect. If you want higher assurance, ask the publisher for a homepage/repository or an official release channel; presence of an authoritative source would raise confidence to high.
